# Shangri-La Yunnan Travel Guide
> Complete travel planning hub for Shangri-La, Yunnan, China. Attractions, weather, altitude guide, hotels, transport, costs, food, and FAQs — all on one page.

## Core Pages
- [Home]: https://shangri-la-yunnan.com - Complete 2026 travel guide with 25+ content modules
- [About]: https://shangri-la-yunnan.com/about - Team credentials, 200+ days first-hand experience in Yunnan
- [Privacy]: https://shangri-la-yunnan.com/privacy - No cookies, no tracking, no analytics

## Attractions
- [Pudacuo National Park]: https://shangri-la-yunnan.com/attractions/pudacuo-national-park - Alpine lakes, wetlands, rare black-necked cranes
- [Songzanlin Monastery]: https://shangri-la-yunnan.com/attractions/songzanlin-monastery - Largest Tibetan Buddhist monastery in Yunnan (1679)
- [Dukezong Old Town]: https://shangri-la-yunnan.com/attractions/dukezong-old-town - 1,300-year-old Tibetan quarter, world's largest prayer wheel
- [Napa Lake]: https://shangri-la-yunnan.com/attractions/napa-lake - Seasonal highland lake, yak grazing, mountain backdrop
- [Tiger Leaping Gorge]: https://shangri-la-yunnan.com/attractions/tiger-leaping-gorge - World-class 2-day trek, one of deepest river gorges
- [Meili Snow Mountain]: https://shangri-la-yunnan.com/attractions/meili-snow-mountain - Sacred 6,740m peak, iconic sunrise at Feilai Temple
- [Balagezong Canyon]: https://shangri-la-yunnan.com/attractions/balagezong-canyon - Hanging coffins, glass skywalk, Tibetan villages
- [Baishuitai Terraces]: https://shangri-la-yunnan.com/attractions/baishuitai-terraces - Natural travertine pools, "China's Pamukkale"
- [Haba Snow Mountain]: https://shangri-la-yunnan.com/attractions/haba-snow-mountain - Accessible 5,396m summit climb for fit beginners

## Food & Culture
- [Yak Butter Tea]: https://shangri-la-yunnan.com/food/yak-butter-tea - Traditional Tibetan staple beverage
- [Yak Hotpot]: https://shangri-la-yunnan.com/food/yak-hotpot - Highland comfort food with mushrooms
- [Tsampa]: https://shangri-la-yunnan.com/food/tsampa - Roasted barley flour, Tibetan daily bread
- [Matsutake Mushrooms]: https://shangri-la-yunnan.com/food/matsutake-mushrooms - Seasonal Yunnan delicacy (July-September)
- [Tibetan Barley Wine]: https://shangri-la-yunnan.com/food/tibetan-barley-wine - Fermented highland barley alcohol
- [Morning Chanting]: https://shangri-la-yunnan.com/food/morning-chanting - 6:30 AM Buddhist ceremony at Songzanlin
